thread:
raymond.c: FYI PartnerX asked for a compact partner repo for marketplace onboarding. They want multi-cloud examples (AWS, Azure, GCP), a tiny terraform module, marketplace manifest, and a CI smoke test. ETA: 1 week.
leena.p: ok. do they need full refarch or a minimal "drop-in" sample for SIs?
oliver-sd: minimal. SIs prefer copy/paste that runs in <30m. suggest: modules/partnerx-serving/, examples/aws-minimal/, examples/azure-minimal/, examples/gcp-minimal/, ci/, marketplace/manifest.yaml, docs/ONBOARDING.md
anna-market: manifest must include product_id, vendor_contact, support_contact, sla_tier, regions, hardware_profiles, compatibility matrix, and short marketing blurb. also add `cert_level` and `packaging_format` fields for our portal.
raymond.c: can we include an ARM template stub for Azure and a small Deployment Manager YML for GCP so integrators see both patterns?
oliver-sd: yes. azure/azure-simple.json (ARM) + gcp/deploy.yaml. keep cloud templates minimal: single VM + startup script that pulls a tiny echo server.
marketplace-bot: Note: manifest schema v2 requires fields: product_id, vendor_contact, support_contact, sla_tier, cert_level, packaging_format, regions. Missing: cert_level. See https://partners.redwood.ai/marketplace-specs/v2
sre_jess: CI idea: workflow runs terraform init/apply against a tiny container-based stub (no GPU), run healthcheck, then terraform destroy. Keep timeouts small. Example step: `terraform apply -auto-approve -var-file=examples/aws-minimal/deploy.tfvars -parallelism=10 -lock-timeout=10s`
leena.p: include a `manifest-lint.py` script that flags missing keys and warns if hardware_profiles list is empty. anna, can you add suggested values for hardware_profiles (e.g. t4, g4dn, a100) and quantization hints?
anna-market: will do. also include `size_estimates` (vCPU, RAM, disk, approximate cost tier) so customers pick right instance. add `compatibility` block showing recommended runtime (CUDA version, driver) and a `quantization_recommendation` field (e.g. int8, fp16).
oliver-sd: README should have quickstart snippet. sample terraform variables example to paste: ```hcl variable "instance_type" { type = string default = "t4g.medium" } variable "replication" { type = number default = 1 } ```
raymond.c: add an ONPREM adapter note: toggle `provider = "onprem"` and override `api_endpoint`. SIs need packaging steps for air-gapped customers.
sre_jess: CI example action for smoke: ```yaml name: partnerx-smoke on: [push] jobs: smoke: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v3 - name: init terraform run: cd modules/partnerx-serving && terraform init - name: apply smoke run: terraform apply -auto-approve -var-file=../../examples/aws-minimal/deploy.tfvars -no-color -input=false -timeout=15m - name: healthcheck run: curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/health || exit 1 - name: destroy run: terraform destroy -auto-approve -var-file=../../examples/aws-minimal/deploy.tfvars ```
marketplace-bot: Reminder: attach `support_contact` as an email and `sla_tier` as one of [gold, silver, bronze]. Also include `onboarding_checklist.md` in docs.
leena.p: owner? oliver + anna to draft module + manifest. raymond to own partner comms. deadline: PR by next Tue, review by Fri.
anna-market: ill add manifest examples and a small `manifest-validate.py` linter that returns non-zero on missing required fields.
raymond.c: thanks. once merged we schedule a 30-min handoff with PartnerX SIs and share the repo link. :rocket:
